text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Israeli-Palestinian talks fail; Arafat starts tour of Europe. Foreign Minister Amr Moussa discusses Middle East peace process in talks with European counterparts in Luxembourg.
- Rescue workers race time to extract survivors from the "building of death" after apartment block collapsed on Sunday.
- President Hosni Mubarak and Jordan's King Hussein to hold talks in Sinai resort of Sharm el-Sheikh today focusing on the developments in the peace process.
- Mubarak seeks all rescue help for those suffering from the building collapse as officials follow the operations. Kuwait's emir sends condolences.
- Moussa says the peace process faces grave challenges.
- 13 are dead and 19 people rescued from the rubble of the collapsed building in Cairo suburb. Ninety feared buried.
- 318 Egyptians can vote in U.S. elections.
- China's prime minister expresses his country's intention to increase economic ties with Egypt. China supports re-election of Boutros-Ghali in the United Nations.
